videos.title: Hands On with the iPhone Duo: Apple's First Foldable Phone
videos.description:
I just got a few minutes to play with the iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable iPhone, after jostling my way through the throngs of journalists, creators, and influencers at the Steve Jobs Theater. As expected from Apple, which gave us the iPhone Air, the iPhone Duo is a stunning device to hold in your hands.
